name: Forgetfulness of the Lord (removed in the fourth stage)
gloss: The forgetfulness that Kauṇḍinya names as what the fourth stage's purification removes: in the cremation ground remembrance of Rudra is the action and union with Rudra the gain (Pañcārthabhāṣya 5.29).

name: Fitness for the second stage (knowledge, reduced impurity, the teacher's leave)
gloss: The condition Kauṇḍinya sets before the ascetic goes among people to court dishonour: he has gained knowledge, his impurity is reduced and he has the teacher's leave (Pañcārthabhāṣya 3.12-17).
